remarks: Spacious 4-bedroom 3 full bathroom Ranch style home with a bonus finished basement. Home is conveniently located across the street from Woodway Country Club and 1 mile from Talmadge Hill train stop. The Merritt Parkway is also located approximately 2 minutes from the home, which allows for easy commute to the city, close to shopping and dining. There is plenty of parking in front of the home and on the side driveways. The current tenant is in the process of moving, and the home has some boxes and moving supplies throughout.
